evidence.finding: Read the complete collision caller and target body. The caller invokes the helper when its ground check fails. The helper calls ftCommon_8007D60C and enters state 354 with transition_flags0, the current animation frame, and animation speed 1. It contains no invisibility assignment or accessory callback installation.

Read both complete ending-entry routines, including the cited L648-L668 range. They enter states 351 and 354 at frame zero, restore visibility, install the accessory callback, and scale saved velocity. This supports distinguishing initial ending entry from continuation of an existing ending animation.

Travel collision handling uses a distinct ground-to-air helper, ftZd_SpecialHi_80139F6C, which enters state 353 with transition_flags1, animation speed zero, and invisibility enabled. Its complete body independently supports the proposed End distinction.

The motion-state table binds state 351 to ftZd_SpecialHi_Coll, state 353 to aerial travel callbacks, and state 354 to ftZd_SpecialAirHi callbacks. Together with the transition bodies, this establishes continuation from the grounded ending phase into its aerial counterpart.

Read the complete cited Mewtwo handler. It has the analogous current-frame ground-to-air transition structure. This is corroborative evidence only; acceptance rests on Zelda's bodies and callback table, not the Mewtwo alias.
